messages:
Ashley: Heads-up — perf-nightly shard failing on a100-mig nodes with repeated Xid/kernel OOM during warmup. Seen on 3 consecutive runs. Can someone rerun shard 12 without MIG or look quickly? :eyes:
ci-bot: test-runner/2765432100 failed (exit 137). Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/2765432100
rajiv: I can take a look. Do you have a short kernel log + image/driver info?
Ashley: driver=535.54, cuda=12.2, image=registry.redwood/ai-infer:nightly-2026-03-16. Kernel snippet: "NVRM: Xid (31): 00000000: 13, PID=4021, GPU=000000:05:00.0, Ch 00000000" followed by repeated oom_kill entries during warmup. No obvious user OOM.
Marco: That pattern smells like MIG isolation/interference after the recent MIG scheduler tweak. Could also be driver regression, but first repro without MIG.
rajiv: Agreed. Ashley — can you paste the shard id and the node name? I'll queue a rerun with NO_MIG and single-GPU affinity.
Ashley: shard=12, node=n-a100-12. Proposed quick command: `kubectl -n ci annotate pod perf-nightly-12 redwood.dev/no-mig=true && ./ci/retry.sh 2765432100 --shard=12 --env=NO_MIG=1`
rajiv: doing that now. I'll also tail dmesg + nvidia-smi. If it still OOMs I'll roll the image back to driver 535.31 for a bisect.
ci-bot: rerun queued: 2765432301 by rajiv (runner=perf-runner-12).
Olivia: @eng-infra FYI — please don't cordon/reboot n-a100-12 while rajiv is troubleshooting.
rajiv: Started. dmesg looks cleaner so far, no immediate Xid. Monitoring memory and KV cache allocation.
Marco: If this passes, we should revert the MIG scheduling tweak in PR #4021 and add a focused test to exercise warmup with MIG/contender jobs.
Ashley: OK will open the revert if green. If rerun fails, schedule a driver bisect window tomorrow 10:00 PST and tag infra.
sre-bot: Reminder: if this leaks into production or causes customer impact, create an incident and tag severity. Current scope: CI-only.
rajiv: rerun finished — PASS on shard 12 with NO_MIG. :thumbsup: Leaving notes in the CI run about the workaround.
Ashley: nice, thanks. I'll hold the MIG tweak revert + test plan. Filing follow-up: track a scoped bisect (drivers 535.31 -> 535.54) next week to be safe.
Marco: thanks team.
Olivia: :thumbsup:
